name: shortest_distance_leetcode
text: Given a weighted, undirected graph of V vertices numbered 0 to V-1 and a source vertex src, find the shortest distance of all vertices from src.

name: kruskal_pseudocode
text: KRUSKAL(G): A = empty set; for each vertex v: MAKE-SET(v); sort edges of G by weight; for each edge (u,v) in order: if FIND-SET(u) != FIND-SET(v): add (u,v) to A; UNION(u,v); return A

name: topological_cpp
text: vector<int> order; queue<int> q; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (indeg[i] == 0) q.push(i); while (!q.empty()) { int u = q.front(); q.pop(); order.push_back(u); for (int v : adj[u]) if (--indeg[v] == 0) q.push(v); } return order;
